title: Sigurnost RAG sistema
summary: Kontrola pristupa po dokumentu u fazi pretrage, izolacija tenanata, zaštita vektorske baze, rizici embeddinga (OWASP LLM08) i odbrana od trovanja RAG korpusa.
summary_en: Document-level access control at retrieval time, tenant isolation, vector store protection, embedding risks (OWASP LLM08) and defense against RAG corpus poisoning.
